name: Administrator creates linked academic structure
description: Creates linked academic records and verifies they remain available after refresh.
steps: Sign in as an Administrator or Super Admin
Create a faculty, department, programme and course in sequence
Refresh the module and verify the records remain listed
expected: All linked academic records remain visible after refresh; invalid parent references are rejected.

name: Lecturer publishes an announcement to a selected audience
description: Verifies a lecturer can publish an announcement for a selected audience and that the announcement persists.
steps: Publish a titled message for Students
expected: The published announcement appears in the lecturer's view and is delivered only to the selected audience.

name: Student views announcements for their audience
description: Verifies students can read announcements addressed to all users or students but not staff-only updates.
expected: Only published announcements for Everyone or Students are visible.

name: Student scans a session QR and submits attendance for review
description: Verifies the active session QR can be read by a supported mobile browser and creates a pending attendance record.
steps: Sign in as a Lecturer and create a live attendance session
Sign in as a Student on a supported mobile browser and open Check in
Scan the QR code and submit the captured code
expected: The student receives a pending verification confirmation and cannot submit a second check-in for the same session.

name: Lecturer verifies attendance only for own sessions and students cannot publish announcements
description: Verifies lecturer review ownership and that students cannot create or modify staff announcements.
steps: Sign in as a Lecturer and review a pending record from a session they created
Attempt to review a record from another lecturer's session
Sign in as a Student and attempt to publish an announcement
expected: Only owned attendance records can be reviewed; students cannot publish announcements.
